C218769: All assessments and procedures will be performed in accordance with the Schedule of Activities. Any clinically significant findings will be followed up as appropriate.
C218770: Screening assessments will include medical history, physical examination, vital signs, 12-lead ECG, and clinical laboratory tests to confirm eligibility.
C218771: Baseline assessments will be performed within 72 hours prior to the first dose of investigational product and will serve as the reference point for efficacy and safety evaluations.
C218772: Efficacy will be assessed using the validated Primary Endpoint Scale at each scheduled visit. Secondary efficacy endpoints will also be assessed per the Schedule of Activities.
C218773: Safety will be assessed through adverse event monitoring, clinical laboratory tests, vital signs measurements, physical examinations, and 12-lead ECGs.
C20989: A full physical examination will be performed at screening, and targeted physical examinations will be performed at subsequent visits as clinically indicated.
C154628: Vital signs including blood pressure, heart rate, respiratory rate, and temperature will be measured at each visit after the participant has rested for at least 5 minutes.
C168186: A standard 12-lead ECG will be performed at screening, Day 1 (pre-dose), and at the end of treatment visit.
C218774: Clinical laboratory assessments including haematology, biochemistry, coagulation, and urinalysis will be performed at screening and at scheduled visits per the Schedule of Activities.
C92949: Pregnancy testing will be performed for women of childbearing potential at screening and throughout the trial per the Schedule of Activities.
C218775: Suicidal ideation and behaviour will be assessed using the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS) at each visit.
C218776: Blood samples for pharmacokinetic analysis will be collected on Day 1 and at Week 4 per the detailed PK sampling schedule.
C218777: A single blood sample for pharmacogenomic analysis will be collected at baseline. Participation in pharmacogenomic sampling is optional.
C218778: Pharmacodynamic biomarker samples will be collected at screening, Day 1 (pre-dose), and Week 12.
C218779: Other exploratory biomarker samples may be collected as specified in the Schedule of Activities and as described in the laboratory manual.
C218780: Anti-drug antibody samples will be collected at baseline and at the end of treatment visit.
C176849: Healthcare resource utilisation data including hospitalisations and outpatient visits will be collected at each scheduled visit.
